description: Phase 1 MCP tool contract. This manifest does not start a real MCP server and every tool maps to local CLI or Backend Mock behavior.

tools.name: get_real_llm_runtime_config
tools.description: Return a redacted read-only summary of OpenAI-compatible real LLM runtime environment variables. It never returns API key values, imports SDKs, creates clients, sends requests, or creates artifacts.

tools.name: analyze_material
tools.description: Statically analyze a local Markdown, text, or Shell material file before DSL generation. No shell commands are executed.

tools.name: workflow_demo
tools.description: Run the local Phase 1 mock main chain and create review tasks for generated DSL outputs.

tools.name: generate_lab_from_source
tools.description: Generate a Lab DSL from a local source file using Backend Mock.

tools.name: generate_exam_from_lab
tools.description: Generate Exam and Grading DSL examples from a Lab id using Backend Mock.

tools.name: generate_ppt
tools.description: Generate a PPT DSL from a local source file using Backend Mock.

tools.name: run_grading
tools.description: Run Phase 1 mock grading from a local Grading DSL file.

tools.name: run_readonly_grading_evidence
tools.description: Run read-only grading evidence collection for low-risk file/json/notebook checks. It only inspects files inside a provided submission directory and does not execute commands, pytest, notebook kernels, shell scripts, or contestant code.

tools.name: run_controlled_grading_evidence
tools.description: Run controlled Docker grading evidence for allowlisted stdout_contains and pytest checks. It executes contestant code only inside a local Docker container with network disabled, read-only submission mount, no image pull, no Notebook kernel, no host execution, no auto approval, and no publish.

tools.name: merge_grading_evidence_reports
tools.description: Merge existing local grading evidence JSON reports into one auditable coverage report. This tool only reads report files and writes a merged report; it does not inspect submissions, start Docker, execute pytest, execute notebooks, run shell commands, call a real LLM, auto approve, or publish.

tools.name: run_grading_evidence_auto
tools.description: Run automatic grading evidence orchestration. It always collects read-only evidence first, optionally collects controlled Docker command evidence when explicitly requested, then writes one GRADING_EVIDENCE_AUTO_REPORT for human review. By default it does not execute contestant commands, call a real LLM, auto approve, or publish.

tools.name: create_grading_job
tools.description: Create one local GradingJob staging item from a Grading DSL and submission directory. It only queues local work for the current MVP, writes no production queue or database, and does not execute contestant code by itself.

tools.name: list_grading_jobs
tools.description: List local GradingJob staging items from JSON store or optional local SQLite dbPath. This is a read-only task-flow inspection tool for reviewers and agents.

tools.name: get_grading_job
tools.description: Get one local GradingJob staging item by id from JSON store or optional local SQLite dbPath.

tools.name: run_grading_job
tools.description: Run one local GradingJob synchronously through the existing evidence-auto path and create a GradingRecord for human review. It may execute controlled Docker evidence only if the job was explicitly configured for controlled command evidence; it never auto-approves or publishes.

tools.name: create_grading_record
tools.description: Create one local GradingRecord from an existing grading evidence report. It reads an existing report only, starts no sandbox, changes no AI Task status, and waits for human record review.

tools.name: list_grading_records
tools.description: List local GradingRecord items from JSON store or optional local SQLite dbPath. This is read-only and is used by reviewers and agents to find records waiting for manual review.

tools.name: get_grading_record
tools.description: Get one local GradingRecord by id from JSON store or optional local SQLite dbPath.

tools.name: review_grading_record
tools.description: Record a human review decision for one local GradingRecord. It changes only the record review status, never changes AI Task status, never reruns grading, never imports, and never publishes.

tools.name: record_review_decision_note
tools.description: Record a local human review decision note for a grading review task after evidence review. It writes only REVIEW_DECISION_NOTE artifacts and audit records; it does not change task status, auto approve, execute sandbox code, call a real LLM, import, or publish anything.

tools.name: list_ai_tasks
tools.description: List local AI Task records from the mock store.

tools.name: get_ai_task
tools.description: Get one local AI Task record by id.

tools.name: list_review_tasks
tools.description: List local AI Task records that are waiting for human review.

tools.name: get_grading_result_preview
tools.description: Read an existing local grading report and return a candidate-safe grading result preview. It does not run grading, start Docker, execute contestant code, call a real LLM, auto approve, or publish.

tools.name: get_grading_evidence_readiness
tools.description: Read one or more existing grading evidence reports and return a machine-readable readiness summary for human review. It does not run Docker, pytest, notebooks, contestant code, real LLM calls, auto approval, or publish.

tools.name: get_review_task_summary
tools.description: Get a Phase 1 review queue batch summary for human triage. It does not approve, reject, or publish tasks.

tools.name: get_real_dsl_review_preview
tools.description: Get a read-only review preview for local real LLM generated Lab, Exam, Grading, and PPT DSL artifacts. It validates local DSL files and does not send a new LLM request.

tools.name: create_real_dsl_revision_draft
tools.description: Create a WAITING_REVIEW revision draft for a real LLM generated DSL file from human review feedback. Default providerMode=local is deterministic; optional providerMode=real-llm sends one explicit OpenAI-compatible revision request and still does not publish anything.

tools.name: create_real_dsl_revision_batch_from_preview
tools.description: Create local WAITING_REVIEW revision drafts from RealDslReviewPreview.revisionSuggestions. It consumes an existing local review preview and does not send a new LLM request.

tools.name: get_real_dsl_revision_diff_preview
tools.description: Get a read-only diff preview for local WAITING_REVIEW real DSL revision drafts created by create_real_dsl_revision_batch_from_preview. It compares source DSL files with revised DSL drafts and does not send a new LLM request.

tools.name: create_real_dsl_revision_decision
tools.description: Record a human review decision for one real DSL revision draft from RealDslRevisionDiffPreview. The decision report is local and auditable; it does not merge, auto-approve, publish, or send a new LLM request.

tools.name: promote_real_dsl_revision_candidate
tools.description: Promote an approved real DSL revision decision into a new local WAITING_REVIEW candidate DSL. It copies the revised DSL to a candidate file and does not merge into the source, auto-approve, publish, execute sandbox code, or send a new LLM request.

tools.name: enqueue_real_dsl_revision_candidate_review
tools.description: Create a local WAITING_REVIEW AI Task and DSL Artifact from a promoted real DSL revision candidate so the existing review queue and review detail tools can handle it. It does not approve, publish, execute code, or send a new LLM request.

tools.name: create_lab_template_import_preview
tools.description: Create a local LabTemplateImportPreview from an APPROVED Lab DSL review task. It writes only a local preview JSON, artifact, and audit event; it does not import to the real agent service or publish.

tools.name: create_exam_question_import_preview
tools.description: Create a local ExamQuestionImportPreview from an APPROVED Exam DSL review task. It writes only a local preview JSON, artifact, and audit event; it does not import to the real agent service or publish.

tools.name: create_grading_rule_import_preview
tools.description: Create a local GradingRuleImportPreview from an APPROVED Grading DSL review task. It writes only a local preview JSON, artifact, and audit event; it does not import to the real agent service, execute sandbox code, or publish.

tools.name: create_lab_template_mock_import
tools.description: Write a LabTemplateImportPreview draft into the local mock agent entity store after the source task is APPROVED and an import preview exists. It does not write the real database, call the real agent service import API, or publish.

tools.name: create_exam_question_mock_import
tools.description: Write an ExamQuestionImportPreview draft into the local mock agent entity store after the source task is APPROVED and an import preview exists. Candidate-facing answers remain hidden; no real database import or publish is performed.

tools.name: create_grading_rule_mock_import
tools.description: Write a GradingRuleImportPreview draft into the local mock agent entity store after the source task is APPROVED and an import preview exists. It does not execute a sandbox, run contestant code, write a real database, or publish.

tools.name: get_review_detail
tools.description: Get one review detail view that joins an AI Task, artifacts, workflow steps, review audit events, operation audit events, and publish gating policy.

tools.name: list_agent_entities
tools.description: List local mock agent entity drafts created by local mock-import actions. It can read Backend Core SQLite when coreDbPath is provided, but it does not write a real database, call the real agent service API, or publish.

tools.name: get_agent_entity
tools.description: Get one local mock agent entity draft and its local import activity. It can read Backend Core SQLite when coreDbPath is provided, but it does not send a real platform request or publish.

tools.name: validate_agent_entity_contract
tools.description: Validate the local platform contract mapping file used by import-dry-run. This is local config validation only; it never reads platform tokens, sends network requests, or imports into a real platform.

tools.name: get_agent_entity_readiness_report
tools.description: Read the local platform entity readiness report for Lab, Exam, and Grading mock imports. It only checks local import previews and mock platform entity records; it does not write a real database, call the real agent service import API, or publish.

outputContract.signoffReadyMeans: ready for manual signoff action and not yet signed
outputContract.postSignoffPrePublishChecklistMeans: read-only final human review checklist before any real publish planning

tools.name: get_core_workflow_readiness
tools.description: Read the single-task core workflow readiness report that joins review status, content-quality readiness, platform entity readiness, Grading evidence readiness, and pre-approve decision-note signals. When generated DSL content must be revised before import preview, the report recommends a manual revision request before approve/import steps. It does not approve, import, publish, call a real LLM, execute a sandbox, or access secrets.

tools.name: create_agent_entity_import_dry_run
tools.description: Build a dry-run DTO for a future real platform draft import API call from a local mock agent entity record. It writes only a local report and audit event; it does not send the request, read secrets, write a real database, or publish.

tools.name: agent_internal_publish_request
tools.description: Send one reviewed platform entity import dry-run payload to a configured real platform draft import API endpoint. It requires explicit confirmation flags, reads the platform token only from the environment, never returns token values, and still requires platform-side manual review before publishing.

tools.name: record_agent_entity_publish_result
tools.description: Record a human-reviewed platform-side draft import result after a platform entity import request has been sent. It only writes local audit/result records, does not query the platform, does not return secrets, and does not publish anything.

tools.name: query_agent_publish_status
tools.description: Read the platform-side status for one previously sent draft import request. It sends one read-only GET request to the configured platform API, reads the platform token only from the environment, never returns token values, does not mutate local entity status, and still requires a separate human result record step.

tools.name: record_agent_entity_signoff
tools.description: Record a local human signoff for a platform entity after draft import result review. It writes only local signoff artifacts and audit records; it does not call the platform, approve generated content, or publish anything.

tools.name: record_final_publish_review_decision
tools.description: Record a local final human review decision after platform entity signoff. It does not execute or authorize real publish; it only writes a local final-review artifact and audit event.

tools.name: request_review_revision
tools.description: Record reviewer feedback requesting revisions for a WAITING_REVIEW task. It does not change task status, call a real LLM, or publish anything.

tools.name: regenerate_from_revision_mock
tools.description: Create a new WAITING_REVIEW mock revision task from the latest or selected review revision request. It reuses local DSL artifacts and does not call a real LLM.

tools.name: get_second_confirmation_status
tools.description: Read the mock second-confirmation status for a critical high-risk MCP review intent. It does not confirm or execute anything.

tools.name: list_review_audit_events
tools.description: List local review audit events for approve, reject, and mock publish actions.

tools.name: list_operation_audit_events
tools.description: List local operation audit events for review, environment, and mock grading actions.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List local Phase 1 workflow run logs with step-level trace details.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List local Phase 1 artifact manifest records for material analysis, DSL outputs, and mock reports.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Get one local Phase 1 artifact manifest record by id.

tools.name: get_workflow_run
tools.description: Get one local Phase 1 workflow run log by id.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List Phase 2 Mock workflow capabilities from the local registry. This only discovers workflows and does not execute them.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Get one Phase 2 Mock workflow capability and its contract from the local registry. This only discovers the workflow and does not execute it.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List Phase 1 provider registry. Only the deterministic MockProvider is enabled.

tools.name: get_provider_health
tools.description: Read MockProvider health without contacting a real model provider.

tools.name: mock_provider_generate
tools.description: Generate a deterministic local DSL reference through MockProvider. The result stays WAITING_REVIEW.

tools.name: list_provider_audit_events
tools.description: List local Provider Adapter call audit events for registry, health, direct mock generate, and workflow generation steps.

tools.name: list_mcp_tool_call_records
tools.description: List local MCP Tool mock call records for success, validation failure, and Backend Mock failure paths.

tools.name: create_vm_environment
tools.description: Create a local mock VM environment record. No cloud resource is created.

tools.name: create_notebook_environment
tools.description: Create a local mock Notebook environment record. No cloud resource is created.

tools.name: publish_lab
tools.description: Create a high-risk review intent for publishing a Lab. It does not publish anything.

tools.name: publish_exam
tools.description: Create a high-risk review intent for publishing an Exam. It does not publish anything.

tools.name: destroy_environment
tools.description: Create a critical review intent for destroying an environment. It does not destroy any resource.
